allowedSourceMaterial.overview: A group of covert CIA operatives trailing a potential new energy source are double-crossed by corrupt agent Morgan, who causes a helicopter crash in remote South Africa. The sole survivor, suffering severe amnesia, is nursed to recovery by a kindly native tribe who call him "Whoami" after the question he keeps asking. With the help of a mysterious reporter Christine, Whoami pieces together his past and tracks the turncoat agent and his criminal cohorts.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With no memory of his real past, can the stranded agent untangle his identity before the conspirators who betrayed him close in?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After a corrupt CIA agent causes a devastating helicopter crash in South Africa, an amnesiac commando is nursed by a local tribe and must piece together his forgotten identity alongside an enigmatic reporter.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast, exciting, and lightly comic, delivering brisk action-adventure thrills with an engaging mystery.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Jackie Chan and Benny Chan, this fast-paced action-comedy combines globe-trotting intrigue and physical stunts with lighthearted suspense that keeps you engaged.
